chunk_map.heading: What each of us is for when building gets cheap

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 0 'What each of us is for...': L4 'None of them comes from the agent' - 'them' resolves in-sentence to the prototype, experiment and way of working; L10 'Each answer is one person's first draft' - 'answer' resolves to the three role lines under the header 'What each of us is for'. Harm (unresolvable referent on a wall) absent; closest to violating is L10 'Each answer'.
grep of body for 'lecture|module|earlier|opening|the .* said' -> no positional file pointers; closest L4 names agent/roles directly.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: no 'the X you did/saw' references in body L4-L10; the maintainer note's Day 2 beat 8 is outside the body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess/predict cue or live demo in body

rules_evaluated.evidence: L4 'An agent can help build ... None of them comes from the agent.' plus three role lines is a self-carrying claim; closest to orphan is L10 two-sentence closer, which sits under a full slide.

header 'What each of us is for when building gets cheap' vs body L4-L10: body answers what each role is for; 'when building gets cheap' is carried by L4 'An agent can help build'. Closest: the cheapness premise is implied not stated, still true to the chunk.

No 'Not X. Not Y.' (grep 'Not ' -> 0), no anaphora triple (three role bullets open with distinct role names and each carries a different verb phrase), no superlative, no number+retraction, no abstraction stack; closest L8 'agrees with the team how it works with agents' is concrete.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep of body for beat|surface|firing|compendium|forcing function|mood -> 0 hits; 'first draft' is ordinary English.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L6-L8 bold three role names only (each <=5 words, handle sub-span, never a whole sentence); closest to violating is the count of three on one slide, which is a per-role label list where the sibling-slide test favours handles over the budget. Harm (monoculture of bold lead sentences) absent.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: slide file not yet included in any composed deck (no [T](slides/...) include found outside module-design notes); presence checkable at inclusion

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no Phase/Step headers or numbering in file; check-slide-numbering.js --file exit 0

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/slides/what-each-of-us-is-for.md -> 'OK - 1 files, no page-geometry pointers', exit 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: H2 'What each of us is for when building gets cheap' is a lecture-style claim/orientation heading, not an imperative in an exercise; rule not engaged (orientation headers are not violations).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L10 'Each answer is one person's first draft. The team writes the real one together.' is the closest to a kicker but adds the draft status and the team's role, not a restatement of the header; the three role bullets each add a distinct decision/knowledge/safety move.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: git diff 4f50a398~1 4f50a398 -- file: the '##' line is unchanged; only the PO bullet wording and backing changed, so no inherited bullets answer an old header.
